preconditions.description: The lengths of strings s and t and the parameter k must satisfy the specified bounds.
The lengths of strings s and t must match the provided integers n and m.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Strings s and t must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must either be 'No' or 'Yes' followed by two integers L and R.

postconditions.expression: any(s[i:i+k] + s[j:j+k] == t for i in range(n - k + 1) for j in range(i + k, n - k + 1))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', the concatenation of the two substrings must contain t as a substring.

postconditions.expression: 1 <= L <= n - k + 1 and 1 <= R <= n - k + 1 and L + k <= R
postconditions.description: The indices L and R must be valid and non-intersecting.
